entry.desc: ELMXX-specific namelist settings for the ELMXX build-namelist. ELMXX_NAMELIST_OPTS is normally set as a compset variable and in general should not be modified for supported compsets. It is recommended that if you want to modify this value for your experiment, you should use your own user-defined component sets via using create_newcase with a compset_file argument.

Dataset name for user-created datasets, used with the ELM_USRDAT grid.
The entry id deliberately keeps ELM's name rather than an ELMXX-specific one: cime_config/config_grids.xml resolves the ELM_USRDAT domain file as domain.lnd.${ELM_USRDAT_NAME}_navy.nc, and that file is shared across components. Renaming the variable here would mean forking the grid definition. The ELM_USRDAT grid alias itself already matches ELMXX compsets, since its regex is compset="(DATM|SATM).+ELM" and _ELMXX_ contains ELM.
Unlike ELM, ELMXX does not feed this to a -clm_usr_name option -- it has its own build-namelist and resolves fsurdat itself. The only consumer is the domain path above. The default is UNSET, matching ELM.

definitions_variables.help:
========================================= ELMXX naming conventions ========================================= ELMXX is the Kokkos port of the E3SM Land Model (ELM). It is selected with the LND compset token ELMXX, e.g.
2000_DATM%QIA_ELMXX_SICE_SOCN_SROF_SGLC_SWAV
Note that ELMXX writes its namelist to lnd_in, the same file name used by ELM, since namelist files are named after the component class.
